hooks.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/develop 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD develop 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD main 2>/dev/null); files=$( { git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'; [ -n "$base" ] && git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u); [ -z "$files" ] && exit 0; backend=$(printf '%s
' "$files" | grep -c '^apps/backend/'); frontend=$(printf '%s
' "$files" | grep -c '^apps/frontend/'); [ "$backend" = 0 ] && [ "$frontend" = 0 ] && exit 0; msg='Unverified changes -- run the CI-equivalent Docker checks before calling this done (see ObsidianVault/norma-verificacion-docker.md):'; [ "$backend" != 0 ] && msg="$msg
- Backend: docker compose -f deployments/docker-compose.yml -f deployments/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm backend-test go test ./..."; [ "$frontend" != 0 ] && msg="$msg
- Frontend (node:22-alpine in Docker): pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:ci"; printf '%b' "$msg" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d);process.stdin.on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:s})))"
